perspective:
**Ethan’s available information / subjective reconstruction:**

- Ethan knows Gary Guo is his long-time friend; they met in middle school and have remained close, often supporting each other emotionally and professionally. Ethan knows Gary is a doctor.
- Ethan has noticed Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. This worries Ethan.
- Ethan invited Gary to a two-day weekend retreat for relaxation/rejuvenation, telling Gary his health matters, he hates seeing him like this, and it might give him a new perspective. Gary initially said he appreciated the concern but couldn’t because there was too much to do at the hospital.
- Ethan later observes Gary at the retreat with him. He sees Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work.
- Ethan suspects there is more behind Gary’s overworking than just professional obligations. He confronts Gary, saying they’ve been friends since middle school, Gary can tell him anything, and he is there to help, not judge.
- Gary tells Ethan, “It’s complicated,” and that he didn’t want to burden Ethan with his problems. Gary then opens up to Ethan about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he is facing.
- Ethan feels relief and empathy. He offers help by suggesting they prioritize Gary’s tasks and delegate some responsibilities, saying Gary doesn’t have to do everything himself. Gary agrees and says he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary about his progress and challenges. Ethan sees Gary making efforts to change.
- Gary tells Ethan things are better, that thanks to Ethan’s help he is not as overwhelmed, and that he had time for a movie last weekend. Ethan feels hopeful and proud, tells Gary he is proud of his progress, and reminds him he is there whenever Gary needs to talk.
- After a year, Ethan sees/hears that Gary is managing better. Gary thanks Ethan, says he couldn’t have done it without his support, and says he feels more in control now.
- Ethan decides to step back but tells Gary he is always just a call away if needed, that he knows Gary has got this, and to keep up the great work.
